title: 32nd sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/32/2024).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 25/2024 to 28/2024).
Economic Committee report on the Foreign Investment Bill.
Economic Committee report on the bill amending Law No. 18/2014 (Business Registration Act).
Economic Committee report on the bill amending Law No. 2/2006 (Maldives Securities Act).
Social Affairs Committee report on the bill amending Law No. 29/2015 (Health Services Act).
Report of the joint committee of the National Development and Heritage Committee and the Decentralisation Committee on the Built Environment Planning and Administration Bill.
Report of the joint committee of the National Development and Heritage Committee and the Decentralisation Committee on the bill amending Law No. 7/2010 (Decentralisation Act).
Judiciary Committee report on the bill amending Law No. 5/2019 (Legal Profession Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to approve old minutes and take up seven committee reports on bills including foreign investment, business registration, securities, health services, built environment planning, decentralisation and the legal profession.
